verdict.rationale: Convex documents a public HTTP API: a deployment's public functions are exposed at public HTTP endpoints, and you can call them and get results back as values (convex-docs-9, convex-docs-31). This is complemented by a documented CLI that can run functions programmatically (convex-docs-18) and an official MCP server for agents (convex-docs-10, convex-probe-4). The OpenAPI probe returning 404 means no machine-readable spec was found; it does not contradict the documented API. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, evidence of a documented management/admin API beyond calling user-defined functions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
